item.title: Building Scalable Enterprise Solutions
item.description:
The Challenge

Developing scalable enterprise solutions across SaaS, conversational AI and media services required balancing evolving product requirements, technical architecture, user needs and commercial objectives.

My Role

Progressed from Programmer Analyst to Technical Lead, contributing to technical product development, engineering coordination, requirements management and product delivery.

What I Did

Cognizant Sync Drive — SaaS Platform
  • Managed subfolder sharing, notifications and digital signature features across multiple devices.
  • Prioritized product enhancements using market research and user testing.
  • Collaborated with developers to establish a clustered AWS environment.
  • Worked with senior management to re-architect the online editing feature.
Chatbot Test Automation Platform
  • Directed the development of a chatbot evaluation platform supporting IBM Watson, Amazon Lex and Dialogflow.
  • Managed project scope, objectives and technical requirements throughout design, development and testing.
  • Facilitated daily scrum meetings for a distributed engineering team of 10+.
Audio-Video-as-a-Service Platform
  • Contributed to a low-cost media solution supporting cloud and on-premises deployment.
  • Managed requirements gathering, technical documentation and project reporting.
  • Participated in application re-engineering to enable workload-based scaling rather than CPU-based scaling.

Results

  • Contributed to a 10% increase in annual revenue through the re-architecture of online editing capabilities.
  • Enabled chatbot evaluation across three conversational AI platforms.
  • Supported the transition toward workload-based application scalability.

item.title: Recovering a High-Risk Technical Project
item.description:
The Challenge

A high-risk technical delivery project faced stalled sprint execution, unresolved infrastructure blockers, an overgrown backlog, and recurring weekly client escalations.

My Role

As Technical Project Manager, I stepped in to stabilize delivery operations, align engineering and stakeholder teams, and restore release predictability.

What I Did

  • Restructured sprint ceremonies and introduced backlog readiness standards.
  • Resolved critical infrastructure blockers and cross-team dependencies.
  • Refined and prioritized the backlog, removing outdated requirements.
  • Established structured delivery reporting and clear escalation practices.
  • Protected engineering focus time across UX/UI, QA, DevOps, and development streams.

Results

  • Stabilized the high-risk delivery stream within approximately three weeks.
  • Doubled sprint velocity from 40 to 80 story points, sustaining the improvement for five months.
  • Coordinated international platform delivery across 13 European markets
  • Coordinated 10 consecutive on-schedule production releases.
  • Eliminated recurring weekly client escalations.

item.title: Shaping Community-Driven Products
item.description:
The Challenge

Developing globally used open-data products, Wikidata and Wikibase, required balancing diverse community needs, complex technical requirements, and product priorities while improving existing data tools and workflows.

My Role

As IT Product Manager, I supported product strategy and development by translating community requirements, user research, and analytical insights into actionable technical requirements and process improvements.

What I Did

  • Analyzed product performance and user behavior to inform product strategy.
  • Conducted research to identify pain points in internal data tools and data entry workflows.
  • Translated stakeholder requirements into user stories with detailed acceptance criteria in Phabricator.
  • Documented existing business processes using BPMN standards.
  • Contributed to technical initiatives focused on Wikidata constraint validation and item quality evaluation..

Results

  • Increased user satisfaction by 20%.
  • Optimized data entry processes through user research and workflow improvements.
  • Improved requirements clarity through structured user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Supported data-driven product strategy and roadmap alignment.

item.title: Website Migration
item.description:
The Challenge

A large-scale digital platform migration involving 300+ websites across Germany and Switzerland required coordinated technical implementation, platform alignment, and release planning while maintaining existing production operations.

My Role

Led end-to-end migration planning and delivery, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, managing technical dependencies, and aligning implementation priorities with stakeholder requirements.

What I Did

  • Planned and coordinated website migrations across OpenCMS and Drupal environments.
  • Managed technical dependencies, engineering resources, and release sequencing.
  • Coordinated development, UX/UI, QA, infrastructure, content, analytics, and SEO stakeholders.
  • Aligned component development and design requirements with engineering teams.
  • Coordinated analytics tracking, consent management, and digital accessibility requirements.
  • Managed go-live activities, stakeholder communication, and post-launch support.

Results

  • Managed migration delivery for 300+ websites across Germany and Switzerland.
  • Successfully managed onboarding and offboarding of 5+ developers within one year, maintaining uninterrupted delivery with zero release delays.
  • Supported production readiness and operational continuity throughout the migration lifecycle.
